_source: Five Parsecs: Tactics p.166 (Ystrik (Manipulators) profiles and Special Rules). Units are composed from data/tactics/army_builder.json (pp.133-139); weapons come from data/tactics/tactics_weapons_master.json (p.181)

species.description: Psionic manipulators who use mental abilities to influence the battlefield. Ystrik characters can project fear and confusion.

traits.name: Dislike of Physical Combat
traits.description: Manipulators only Hit on a 5+ when using Melee weapons or assaulting vehicles. They Fear any figure with more KP than themselves.

traits.name: Rapid Analysis
traits.description: When making any die roll based on Savvy, Manipulators count any roll of a natural 1 as a 6.
